sources.entry: Beautiful.ai - An AI-powered presentation tool that automates the design process, helping you create beautiful slides effortlessly.

summary.name: Beautiful.ai
summary.one_liner: Beautiful.ai is an AI presentation platform that builds brand-consistent slides using auto-aligning Smart Slide layouts and an outline-first "Create with AI" workflow.
use_cases: Create pitch decks and proposals quickly
Build branded presentations across a company
Turn a document or outline into slides
Send recorded walkthroughs to people who missed a meeting
Share decks with tracked views and protected links
summary.what_it_does: Beautiful.ai generates presentations from a topic, prompt, pasted outline, or source document, starting with an editable text outline before producing slide designs. Its Smart Slides auto-adjust spacing, alignment, and hierarchy as content changes, with over 300 layouts covering data, comparisons, timelines, quotes, and image grids. Teams can define themes, fonts, logos, and templates once and share them across decks, with locked themes and permissions. Presentations can include animations, voice-overs, and live linked charts, and can be shared through tracked links or exported to PDF and PPTX. The page also includes a built-in library of stock images, videos, and icons.
notable: Smart Slides that auto-realign content as you edit
Outline-first Create with AI workflow that lets you edit structure before generating designs
Brand controls, shared template libraries, and locked themes for teams
Voice-over, recorded walkthroughs, and view/engagement tracking on shared decks
caveats: Free 14-day trial; ongoing plans and enterprise pricing require contacting sales or viewing the pricing page
Enterprise features such as SSO and advanced permissions are aimed at organizations
